player.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
player.physicalDescription: 7-foot center with broad shoulders and long arms, athletic frame, short dark hair, neatly trimmed beard, tattoos on his arms, warm expressive face that shows every emotion
player.archetype: The big man with a dreamer's touch, sent away and redeemed in the city

figure.name: Joseph
figure.attributeDescription: the ketonet passim - a radiant coat of many colors whose stripes glow and ripple like liquid light
figure.clothing: the legendary coat of many colors worn open over a simple linen tunic, leather sandals
figure.physicalDescription: young handsome Hebrew man, short dark beard, dark curly hair, olive skin, dreamy far-seeing eyes
figure.archetype: The dreamer who was sent away and rose to glory in a new land

connection.thematic: Sent away by their own, both rose to glory in a new home - and neither ever hid his heart
connection.narrative: Joseph was cast out by his brothers and became second only to Pharaoh. Towns was traded away and became a champion in New York. Joseph wept openly more than anyone in Genesis; Towns plays every emotion out loud.
connection.relationship: Exiled dreamers who wore their hearts - and their colors - for everyone to see

scripture.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם עָלַי רָעָה אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה
scripture.english: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.

connection.receipt: Traded to New York in 2024; won the 2026 title with the highest single-postseason plus-minus in league history (+258)

interactions.description: Karl-Anthony Towns and Joseph standing together as equals
